**주제:** Re: Polaris/ 210K Ore Carrier for VALE  
  

Dear Cecilia,

  

Thank you for your timely update.

  

I checked directly with Polaris Newbuilding team head following your mail. A few points to share:

  

1. We previously understood that Seaspan had taken all VALE contracts. Thanks to your update, I re-confirmed this with Polaris — and as you indicated, that information is not accurate. Polaris confirmed they are still actively engaged with VALE, and their contract negotiations are nearly concluded.
    

  

2. Regarding Dajin Heavy Industry — Polaris had only one initial meeting with them and has since dropped them completely. Dajin is no longer under consideration.
    

  

3. The expected order structure is 4 vessels in total, on a 2 firm + 2 option basis. Polaris is being cautious about disclosing further details at this stage.
    

  

Since Dajin is out, I think the question now is which shipyard Polaris will proceed with. Let's keep exchanging information on this.

  

_Note: I will separately re-confirm whether the vessel type is a 210K Ore Carrier or 210K Bulk Carrier (Newcastlemax) and revert._

  

  

**_Best Regards,_**

**主题****:** Polaris Chairman Meeting Preparation - Request for Your Insights /// Re: Korean Owner Polaris/ 2+2 210K BC

Dear Mr. Chen,

Good afternoon.

Thank you very much for your valuable information regarding Polaris's Newcastlemax BC project.

This coming Thursday (Feb 6), Mr. Christophe Vaes and I are scheduled to visit Mr. HS Han, the Chairman of Polaris Shipping. As you know, Mr. Han is the ultimate decision-maker who personally selected BV for their recent feeder container project at a South China shipyard.

Your email provided excellent background information, including:

- Polaris's strong BV track record (Capesize/Newcastlemax BCs at SWS, 1,800 TEU feeders at Huanghai S/Y)
- Current orderbook at Nantong Xiangyu with 2 x 210K DWT Newcastlemax BCs using SDARI design
- Expected delivery timeline (end of 2029)

To strengthen our presentation to Chairman Han, could you please provide any additional details from your upcoming yard visit on Feb 3rd, if timing permits? Specifically:

- Design Prototypes: Technical specifications or further details of the SDARI 210K BC design at Nantong Xiangyu
- BV References: Any relevant BV-classed 210K BC references in Chinese yards that we could highlight to demonstrate our strong track record in this field
- Any other insights or recommendations you may have based on your expertise

I understand your yard visit is scheduled just before our meeting, so any quick insights you can share would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you in advance for your continued support, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.

**_Best Regards,_**

**Subject:** Korean Owner Polaris/ 2+2 210K BC

Good Day Dear Christophe and Bill:

Last week I met my friend in Huarong Financial Leasing and heard a new 210K BC relates to Korean ship owner Polaris.

Polaris has COA of VALE and they considered to order 2*210K BC few years ago, while they give up the new building project and chartered some cape because of the high building price. Due to the high cape charter rates currently, Polaris must reconsider newbuilding 2+2*210K BC. According to Huarong Financial Leasing, Polaris will order the vessels by themselves, and the leasing companies will provide financial leasing.

Given the limited slots, Huarong Financial Leasing ask any suggestions of shipyard, and I’ve recommended Nantong Xiangyu S/Y. We believe Huarong Financial Leasing won’t be the only leasing company to support Polaris and I will share the information timely if I heard any related information.

If you have any further questions, pls feel free to contact me.

BR,
